contact_frame: LeftFoot native bone frame, fixed hand matrix from acquisition through pull/hold/unload, runtime frames 39..111.
planted_wrist_note: Floor planting and replanting deliberately use wrist extension; active-airborne maximum excludes those transitions. All151 wrist deviations remain in early-native-readback.json.
object_normal_angle_note: Sampled object contact normals are descriptive, not a force-closure gate. Root accepted meaningful palm/thumb/index contact with remaining digits curved outside the corrected collar.

reach_comparison.authored_change: Continuous shin-relative foot transport and one causally necessary collar/digit re-fit; ankle trajectory, thigh115degrees, knee130degrees and torso/support preserved. This comparison uses actual baseline/current wrists, not an incompatible fixed local grasp in another foot frame.

limits: Nearest-normal signed distances are local diagnostics. Complete decoded triangle crossing results are separate; discrete samples do not certify continuous-time or enclosed-volume nonintersection.
